responsibility: Template makefile used inside the Ada language subdirectory to build GNAT components themselves rather than drive the whole GCC build. It contains the low-level recursive rules, tool and flag variables, object dependencies, binder-generated source handling, runtime library variants such as shared/SJLJ/ZCX libgnat builds, and special per-file compilation options needed to compile and debug the Ada front end and runtime support objects from within the language directory.
